description:
Churn Solution's MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your cancellation and retention data. Using natural language, investigate why customers leave, measure the impact of your cancel flows, identify at-risk accounts and revenue, track retention trends, and answer complex questions about your subscription business.

Built for founders and growth, product, and finance teams, it turns Churn Solution data into actionable retention insights and faster decisions.

defaultPrompt: Which Cancel Flows have the best save rate right now?
Give me a full breakdown of the revenue saved. Use charts where helpful and call out key insights and any at-risk revenue.
